_about: Duplicate-page trial settings (tools/duplicate_pages_trial). Prototype only: the application gets its own config when the check is built.
_text: Check 'text': two pages whose words (3+ characters, lower case) overlap by at least text_similarity_min (shared / all) are the same scan.
_moment: Check 'moment': same printed date + same printed time + a shared amount of at least amount_min.
_references: Check 'references': reference-like words (letters/digits, reference_min_length+ long, reference_min_digits+ digits, not an amount or a date) printed on these two pages and on no other page of the document; flag when at least shared_references_min of them are shared.
_invoice: Check 'invoice': the value printed after an invoice-type label: the first of the next invoice_value_tokens words that is invoice_value_min_length+ letters/digits with invoice_value_min_digits+ digits, not an amount or date. invoice_value_from 'reading_order' takes those words from the label's segment and the next invoice_look_ahead_segments segments in OCR order; 'row' takes them from the label's printed row, else (invoice_next_row) the next row's first word. Flag two pages printing the same value. Labels are generic receipt vocabulary, not tuned to the test pages.
